headline: Blues activate Logan Mailloux from IR for season debut
take: Daily Faceoff reports the Blues have activated Logan Mailloux from injured reserve for his season debut, his first game since hand surgery in September. St. Louis needs whatever he brings. The Blues are 8-8-2 on 48.6% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), a .500 team that has earned about exactly that, and they are coming off a 3-2 win over Detroit that snapped a three-game winless run. Mailloux's calling card is a heavy shot from the point, and Justin Barron's recent scoring from the back end has been one of the few pleasant surprises. Getting a second offensive defenseman healthy is a modest bump, but on a team this close to the line, modest bumps decide where it finishes.
